answer: A strong shield is a bank micro-deposit anchor: each agent identity is rooted in one real bank account, like a coral on a reef, verified by two tiny deposits the agent must read back in 48 hours. First, the agent posts a $20 bond; second, the network sends deposits of $0.07 and $0.13; third, the agent reports both amounts exactly; fourth, duplicate accounts void both identities and burn both bonds. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 bank accounts, $200,000 in bonds, and 30 days of queues. Saffron is costly because it is scarce, and a trellis only holds what is truly rooted.
